caption: Most decimals aren't exact sums of powers of two -- true in every language.

code:
a = 1.0000000000001234
b = 1.0000000000001233
a - b
# 1.0658141036401503e-13
# both had ~16 correct digits;
# the difference has almost none
caption: Subtracting nearly-equal large numbers destroys significant digits.
Floating-point addition isn't associative; fsum tracks the error.

code:
x = 0.1 + 0.2
x == 0.3            # False
np.isclose(x, 0.3)  # True
# |a-b| <= atol + rtol*|b|
# defaults: rtol=1e-5, atol=1e-8
caption: Never use == on floats -- use np.isclose / np.allclose.
